nodes.label: Skeptic Verifier Dispatch Prompt
nodes.rationale: Verbatim prompt re-typing the implementer's report as UNVERIFIED CLAIMS; rationales never downgrade severity; format-forced output (V/X/? verdict lines with file:line, two lanes Issues/Recommendations); calibration floor 'approve unless serious gaps'; restricted status set DONE | BLOCKED. Exists for the gap between a REPORT and the artifact behind it — the one place your own gate cannot reach; never for re-checking your own proven edit.

nodes.label: Cross-Model Skeptic Variant
nodes.rationale: A verifier from a different model family does not share this model's blind spots. Gated by the existence of crossmodel.conf (machine config, not playbook knowledge); probed with a trivial prompt under an OUTER timeout 25 because a CLI can hang past its own limits. Its verdict is still a report, never evidence; unavailability downgrades to same-model with the downgrade stated.

nodes.label: Inversion Pass
nodes.rationale: Before the verdict, list what must be TRUE for the claim to be correct and tag each precondition PROVEN or ASSUMED; every ASSUMED precondition is a candidate finding. Converts confidence into a checkable list — the unverified assumption is where a plausible claim is usually wrong.

nodes.label: Skeptic Inline Mode
nodes.rationale: With no subagent capability (and for review classification when /code-review is unavailable): re-read the diff against the claim->evidence table in a SEPARATE message from the one that wrote the code, same verdict format, same resolution rules. Never verify in the message that implemented.
